description: This file appears to be a PHP script responsible for displaying a form that allows users to select email addresses from certain modules (Accounts, Contacts, Leads) in the vtiger CRM system. It queries the database for email fields, generates a form with checkboxes for each email, and includes JavaScript to process and submit the selected email IDs.

methods.name: passemail
methods.description: JavaScript function that collects selected email IDs, appends email IDs to each, and submits the form.
